A '''Jedi Researcher''' was one of many specialized titles a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] could earn while pursuing the title of [[Jedi Consular]]. Working within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to improve the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] through theory and science. Differing in their skills from the [[Lore Keeper|Jedi Lore Keepers]], the role of the Researcher was outlined by Master [[Sabla-Mandibu]].

==Overview==
Broken down into several specialists, the Researcher were highly qualified in their area of expertise, whether it be biology, archaeology, astronomy, philology or geology.<ref name="TJP" />

===Jedi archaeologist===
{{Main|Jedi archaeologist}}
Jedi archaeologist were Researchers specializing in the acquisition of knowledge related to the [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and the Jedi Order. Working in the field with the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]], archaeologists were all members of the [[Academy of Jedi Archaeology]]. With a special division set aside to [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]], the archaeologists were greatly active during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] as they discovered ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] in hopes of keeping them from the Sith.<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref>

===Jedi astronomer===
[[File:Force_Astrogation_FDCR.png|thumb|left|200px|A Jedi Astronomer uses the Force to perform astrogation tasks]]
The study of astronomy within the Order was particularly important, as these Jedi were responsible for [[Astrogation/Legends|plotting routes]] to secret Jedi-held planets, such as [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Because they were experts at locating [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] and [[Quasar/Legends|quasars]], Astronomers could often times be found traveling along the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] plotting new routes, or in the Temple updating and maintaining the [[High Council holomap room/Legends|galaxy holomap displays]].<ref name="TJP" />

===Jedi linguist===
Those Jedi who studied philology, or language, were known as linguists. These individuals would endeavor to understand the ways that different species communicated with each other. A [[Chief Linguist]] during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]], Master [[Jorus Trass]] was known for uncovering the secrets of the [[Tarasin Skintone Language]], and detailing his research in the document entitled, ''[[Shades of Meaning]]''.<ref name="Shades of Meaning">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011011a_shades&c=swlfc|text=Shades of Meaning}}</ref>

===Jedi biologist===
{{Main|Jedi Biologist}}
Experts in biology, these Researchers studied new species data received from the ExplorCorps. With great insight into the inner workings of alien flora and fauna, these Jedi were masters of [[Plant Surge|''Consitor Sato'']], a [[Force power/Legends|technique]] obtainable through mastery of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Master [[Bowspritz]] was a famed biologist in the years following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], contributing data on species strong in the Force to the guidebook, ''The Jedi Path''.<ref name="TJP" />

===Jedi geologist===
{{Main|Jedi geologist}}
The [[Geologist/Legends|geologists]] of the Jedi Order were experts in the field of [[Wikipedia:geology|geology]] and served in a similar capacity as the archeologists. Working closely with the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], the geologists helped identify minerals in the soil that would be conducive for plant growth.<ref name="TJP" /> A unique event happened in [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]] when geologist [[Michael Tandre]] crash landed on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orellon II]]. Teaching the native [[Kentra]] the ways of the [[Sword, Plow, and Spirit]], Tandre created a peaceful religion known as the [[Holy Order of the Je'ulajists]].<ref name="The Prophecy">{{JournalCite|2|The Prophecy}}</ref>
